title: Karyo kit
description: A kit (kit.json in karyo/kits/<name>/) adds node kinds (a card template, style, details sections, a fields schema and a legend entry) and/or plate types (views composed from the engine's pieces) to any project. Kits are data and templates; a `script` plate type is the one exception: it runs the kit's own JavaScript in a sandboxed frame, and only once the user trusted that exact version of the kit (docs/KITS.md "Code in kits"). See docs/KITS.md. Each node kind lives in kinds/<kind>/ as a component (component.json, template.html, style.css); its component.json is checked against $defs/kind.

name.description: The kit's name: its folder's name.

description.description: One sentence: what the kit adds.

kinds.description: The node kinds this kit adds: folders under kinds/. Omitted: every folder there.

plates.description: Plate types: views composed from the engine's pieces, drawn from a project's model.

id.description: Unique among the plate types a project sees (a nearer kit's wins).

title.description: What the plate type is called in the project view and the gallery ("Sequence").

view.description: The engine view it composes: board (the structure board), trace (a recorded flow on its map), tour (a tour's timeline), sequence (a recorded flow as lanes and messages); or script: drawn by the kit's own JavaScript (`script`), in a sandboxed frame, once the user trusts this version of the kit.

from.description: What one plate is drawn from: the whole model (one plate per model), a recorded flow (one per flow) or a tour (one per tour). board takes model; trace and sequence take flow; tour takes tour.

options.description: View options. sequence: durations (bool, default true), group (bool, one band per top-level call, default true), fold ('auto', the default: fold lanes that belong together into one expandable lane when the flow has too many; 'none'; or explicit groups of node ids). board: bench (bool, open in Bench). script: anything; the script gets them.

script.description: view script: the kit's ES module that draws the plate, a .js or .mjs file inside the kit's folder (plates/radial.js). It exports render(host, ctx), and optionally update(host, ctx) and dispose(host).

deterministic.description: view script: the script draws the same picture from the same inputs (no clock, no randomness), so stills and lint render it; without it they show a notice instead.

size.description: view script: the plate's logical size in px (default 960 x 600).

filter.description: Which nodes the plate draws (board and sequence): a node is kept when it matches every list given. neighbours adds the nodes one relationship away.

id.description: Not one of the board's own: summary, calls, checks.

noun.description: What its items are called (items marked data-item="<name>").

keywords.description: Other words that name it (openDetails and Jarvis match them).

template.description: A template file in the kind's folder: the section view shows it.

compact.description: A shorter template for the small card panel (default: template).

kind.description: component.json of a node kind: the component format (docs/EXPLAINERS.md) plus a node block. props is the JSON Schema of the node's fields (MNode.fields); example holds example fields.

props.description: JSON Schema (object) of the node's fields.

size.description: The card's size on boards (px): layouts place and route by it.

example.description: Example fields: `karyo kit check` renders the card and sections with them.

label.description: The kind's name on its cards (default: the kind).

glyph.description: A mark for small places (the tour's map, sequence lanes).

category.description: The category of its nodes that declare none.

sections.description: Details sections, after the board's own.

mini.description: A template for small places (default: glyph and label).

exampleNode.description: The node `karyo kit check` renders the example with.
